solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cheat with contract

definitions.meaning: to deceive or swindle someone, as a con artist does a mark
to make smaller or narrower, as a tailor does to a loose garment

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are idioms: fooling a victim, and tightening clothing by sewing in the seams.

clue.text: Composition that calls for assurance of touch

definitions.text: Composition that calls for assurance of touch

parts.words: Composition that calls for assurance of touch
parts.note: a showy keyboard piece needing a sure touch, its name coming from the Italian for to touch

explanation.definitionFit: This virtuoso piece for organ or harpsichord shows off a player's dexterity, named from Italian toccare.

clue.text: His contacts all turned out to be valuable

definitions.text: His contacts all turned out to be valuable

parts.words: His contacts all turned out to be valuable
parts.note: suggests a well-connected businessman, but it is the mythical king whose touch made everything gold

explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this Phrygian king was granted the power to turn whatever he touched into gold.

clue.text: I take road transport to America — he tried flying

parts.note: a car is road transport
US is America

explanation.surface: Someone taking a car to the States rather than trying to fly there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take' is a link here: the pieces simply sit side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this youth flew on wax wings, flew too near the sun and fell.

clue.text: How races are organised? Noone's interested

indicators.note: the two words before are rearranged into a new order, as things put in order are organised

explanation.surface: A remark on how race meetings are arranged, met with general indifference.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are organised' rearranges HOW and RACES; the result is the dismissive retort.
explanation.definitionFit: The retort is an idiom of indifference, saying nobody gives a damn about the matter.

clue.text: Workers' home

parts.note: not housing for labourers but the dwelling of worker bees

explanation.definitionFit: Worker bees live in a colony's man-made box or natural nest of honeycomb.

clue.text: Girl secures employment as baggage carrier

indicators.note: the girl's name holds the word for employment within it

parts.note: Carol is a girl's name
use means employment

explanation.surface: A girl finds herself a job as a porter.
explanation.definitionFit: At an airport the rotating conveyor belt brings checked luggage round for passengers to collect.

clue.text: A worn out tree

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the words before are disordered

explanation.surface: A tree that is old and worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: The mountain ash, a small tree with red berries, is another name for it.

clue.text: He's no better, all he makes goes on horses

definitions.text: He's no better, all he makes goes on horses

parts.words: He's no better, all he makes goes on horses
parts.note: sounds like a gambler squandering his earnings on races, but he is a craftsman whose products are put on horses, and no better means not a punter

explanation.definitionFit: This leatherworker makes the seats and harness that riders put on horses.

clue.text: Is able to get five to like the artist's work

parts.note: can means is able
V is the Roman numeral for five
as means like, in the way of

explanation.surface: Someone capable of matching five others to a painter's output.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter works on stretched cloth, and the word also names a finished oil painting.

clue.text: Girl in love getting married was subdued

parts.note: O is love, a nil score in tennis
Vera is a girl's name
wed means married

explanation.surface: A girl in love marries and is quietly overwhelmed by it all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link here: the girl's name sits beside O, not inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To be overawed is to be cowed into silence by respect or fear, a kind of subjugation.

clue.text: More than two part with a pound

parts.note: sever means part, to separate
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: More than two people parting company with a pound between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Several means a few, an indefinite number greater than a pair.

clue.text: Arsenal manager

parts.note: read as the London football club's boss, but it is the person in charge of an armoury's weapons

explanation.definitionFit: This craftsman maintains and keeps the weapons stored in a military store of arms.

clue.text: Fire-escape on board ship

parts.note: not an emergency ladder but the chimney through which smoke from a ship's boilers escapes

explanation.definitionFit: A steamship's smokestack lets the fumes from its furnaces out into the air above deck.

clue.text: Ferns get support in a mountain setting

indicators.note: the mountain word forms a setting, like a jewel's mount, around the support

parts.note: Ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
a rack is a frame that supports things

explanation.surface: Ferns gaining support from their mountainside setting.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a coarse, widespread fern that covers hillsides and moorland.

clue.text: Assistant with first-class degree lost heart

parts.note: A1 is first-class, written here as AI

indicators.note: the word degree loses everything but its outside letters

explanation.surface: A helper with a top degree who has become discouraged.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide is a helper or right-hand person, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Moving picture?

parts.note: not a film in motion but one that moves its audience to weep

explanation.definitionFit: A weepie is a sentimental film designed to make viewers cry, so it is emotionally moving.

clue.text: Royal Horse Artillery after a hooded killer

parts.note: a king is royal
a cob is a sturdy short-legged horse
RA is the Royal Artillery

explanation.surface: The Royal Horse Artillery hunting down a hooded murderer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Royal Horse Artillery' reads as one regiment but splits into three pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's longest venomous snake spreads a hood when threatened and its bite can kill.

clue.text: Divorced ladies to be rehabilitated

indicators.note: the letters of the words before are given a new arrangement, as something rehabilitated is restored to a new form

explanation.surface: Divorced women are to be helped back into society.
explanation.definitionFit: Divorced here means cut off or separated from something, as in divorced from reality.

clue.text: Withstanding underground movement

definitions.meaning: the act of opposing or holding out against force
a secret organisation fighting an occupying power, as in wartime France

explanation.definitionFit: The word means opposition generally and also names the clandestine fighters against occupation.

clue.text: Balance to settle around mid-January

indicators.note: the word for settle goes round the middle of the month

parts.note: to reside is to settle or live in a place

indicators.note: mid- picks the central letter of the word January

explanation.surface: Paying off an outstanding balance around the middle of January.
explanation.definitionFit: What is left over, the remainder, as in the balance of an account.

clue.text: Trendy accountant lived in Peru

parts.note: in means fashionable or trendy
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A fashionable accountant once had a home in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: The pre-Columbian empire of the Andes was centred on Peru, so one of its people lived there.

clue.text: Made a searching examination, by all accounts

definitions.text: Made a searching examination, by all accounts

parts.words: Made a searching examination, by all accounts
parts.note: by all accounts seems to mean reportedly, but the examination covered every set of financial accounts

explanation.definitionFit: Inspecting a firm's financial books officially is what a chartered checker of the records did.

clue.text: On the surface it's a delivery vehicle

parts.note: a float is a milk float, the small electric van British milkmen use for doorstep deliveries

explanation.surface: Describing a delivery van as merely superficial.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat or object that is buoyant stays floating on top of the water.

clue.text: Certainly depend on American backing

indicators.note: turning back means the letters for American are read in reverse

parts.note: rely means depend on

explanation.surface: Surely one can count on support from the Americans.
explanation.definitionFit: Surely is an adverb of assurance meaning without doubt, an everyday synonym.

clue.text: Raise the standard in course at university

parts.note: a run is a course, as a ski run
up means at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: Hoisting the flag over a university course.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoist a flag up a pole is the idiom here; a standard is a banner.

clue.text: Embarrassed-looking Marxist confronted

parts.note: red is a communist or Marxist
faced means confronted

explanation.surface: A communist looking sheepish when challenged.
explanation.definitionFit: Shame makes the cheeks flush crimson, so this compound describes visible embarrassment.

clue.text: Shot for security reasons

definitions.meaning: rushed off suddenly, or a crossbow missile
a sliding bar used to lock a door securely

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a dart or arrow fired from a crossbow, and also the bar that fastens a door.

clue.text: Serve the people present

parts.note: do means serve, as in 'that will do'
a nation is a whole people

explanation.surface: An instruction to wait on the people currently attending.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift handed over to a charity or cause, so a noun meaning a present.

clue.text: Doctor in habit of fighting

indicators.note: the doctor's letters go inside the garment's letters

parts.note: a coat, like a habit, is an outer garment
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: A doctor who habitually picks fights.
explanation.definitionFit: Combat is armed fighting between forces, a direct synonym as a noun.

clue.text: Don't delay construction of deep exit

indicators.note: the letters of the two words after are built into a new form

explanation.surface: An urgent call to get on with building a deep exit tunnel.
explanation.definitionFit: To speed something up or hurry it along is the opposite of postponing it.

clue.text: Desert sometimes washed by the sea

definitions.meaning: to abandon or leave someone helpless
a beach or shore covered by the tide

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means abandon, leaving someone stranded; as a noun it is an old word for a beach.
